question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given

Exemplary
solution:
The correct answer is: **Excellent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Exemplary"** means something that is worth imitating, serving as a desirable model or representing the best of its kind. (अनुकरणीय)

 
 
• **Example: **Her exemplary performance in the project earned her a promotion.
 
 
 
• **"Excellent" **refers to something extremely good or outstanding, often surpassing the ordinary standards. (उत्कृष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **The restaurant is known for its excellent service and delicious food.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Exemplary' **is **'Excellent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Excellent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bad **(खराब): Something of poor quality or low standard.

 
 
• **Example:** The movie received bad reviews from critics.
 
 
 
• **Ordinary **(साधारण): Something that is common, regular, or not special.
 
 
• **Example: **He was just an ordinary student with average grades.
 
 
 
• **Average **(औसत): Something that is typical or usual, not exceptional.
 
 
• **Example:** Her performance was average, nothing out of the ordinary.
